skip: The saved article has about 230 words of substance, and its biography repeats the existing description. It adds only his birth and death dates (9 June 1696 – 14 March 1726), death from smallpox, his rule at Kolhapur 1710-1714, that the step-mother Rajasbai deposed him for her son Sambhaji II, and Tarabai's later claim (late 1740s) that he left a posthumous son, Rajaram II, whom Shahu adopted and whom she called an impostor in 1752: enough for a few sentences, not 260 words.
